name: open-ice-finder
description: Finds open ice (stick & puck, public hockey, coach's ice) at rinks near Arlington, MA

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @openice/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:scraper && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @openice/shared && npm run typecheck -w @openice/scraper && npm run typecheck -w @openice/web && npm run typecheck -w @openice/infra && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @openice/shared && npm run test -w @openice/scraper && npm run test -w @openice/web && npm run test -w @openice/infra
scripts.refresh:local: npm run build:shared && node --import tsx packages/scraper/src/cli.ts
scripts.refresh:rangers: npm run build:shared && node --import tsx packages/scraper/src/rangers-cli.ts
